scope: Notification outbox batch-size and lease-duration validation
finding: Python bool values are integers, so claim_batch previously accepted True as a batch size of one or a one-second lease despite the documented lease minimum.
change: claim_batch now explicitly rejects booleans for limit and lease_seconds, matching the isolated notification worker's validation.
rollback: Revert the boolean type guards and the two parameterized regression cases; no migration or persisted state changed.
limitations: This closes invalid direct-call bounds only; it does not prove live SMTP/webhook delivery, outage recovery, or long-duration worker behavior.
